summary: Completed comprehensive testing of French community donation/sale platform. Backend APIs working correctly with proper authentication and CRUD operations. Frontend fully functional with navigation, form submissions, admin features, and responsive design. Minor backend validation issue identified but overall system is production-ready.

minor_bugs.issue: Backend test initially showed file limit not enforced, but manual testing confirmed it works correctly (returns 400 for >3 files)
minor_bugs.impact: No actual impact - validation is working

passed_tests: Donation creation with and without photos
Sale creation with phone, description, price and photos
Listings page displaying donations and sales
Admin-only deletion functionality with confirmation dialog
Navigation between all pages (Home, Donate, Sell, Listings, Tips, Admin)
